description: This file defines the SmoothFollow class, a MonoBehaviour script in Unity that smoothly follows a target object (usually a camera) by adjusting its position and rotation each frame.

classes.name: SmoothFollow
classes.description: A Unity MonoBehaviour script for smoothly following a target object by adjusting position and rotation.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Initialization method called when the script instance is being loaded. Empty in this implementation.

methods.name: LateUpdate
methods.description: Updates the camera position and rotation each frame to smoothly follow the target.
